reason: A local regex utility that tests patterns, extracts matches and capture groups, performs bounded replacements, and statically explains regex structure.

summaries.zh: 用于测试 JavaScript 正则、提取匹配与捕获组、执行字符串替换并静态解释正则结构的本地工具。
summaries.en: A local utility for testing JavaScript regular expressions, extracting matches and capture groups, performing string replacements, and statically explaining pattern structure.

capabilities: Tests JavaScript regular-expression patterns against bounded text
Finds matches and returns numbered and named capture groups
Performs bounded string replacement using regular-expression replacement syntax
Statically explains regular-expression structure without executing matching
